brief:
Today, 16 November, is a rest day. You trained Push A on 15 November when the plan said rest, so that made seven days in a row (9 to 15 November). Pull A is tomorrow, 17 November, and tomorrow morning's review puts its numbers on the card. The next rest day is 23 November.

Your three questions from 15 November, answered straight:

Chest press, "why stalled, why up and down": it is not stalled. At this gym your top set went 135 on 28 October, 150 on 4 and 9 November, 165 for 9 on 12 November, and 157.5 for 12 on all three sets on 15 November. That is steady progress. The "stalled" label on the Push B chest press is comparing you with 165 for 10 at the Warsaw gym on 30 September, a different machine, so the label is wrong. The same mistake is behind the "stalled" label on the high-to-low crossover, the straight-arm pulldown and the reverse curl, which all went up at this gym. Fixing that label needs a change to the app's code, which this review is not allowed to make; it is flagged for that fix. The up-and-down came from two things. First, most cards opened with a lighter first set; that stops, and every chest press card now has one weight on all three sets. Second, Push A (10 to 12 reps) and Push B (8 to 10 reps) ask different weights on purpose, the split you accepted on 23 July. Next time both days are 165: Push B on 19 November is 165 for 10 on all three, Push A on 22 November is 165 for 11 or better. After that the two days may sit one step apart, Push B heavier for fewer reps, and that is the only reason the weight will differ. If you would rather have one rep range on both days, say so in a note.

Reverse pec deck on every push day: yes, on purpose. It is the only rear-delt exercise on push days. Rear delts get 10 direct sets a week (reverse pec deck 3 on each push day, face pulls 2 on each pull day), which is inside the range. Without it on Push A they would get 7.

No direct triceps work on Push A: the dips are Push A's triceps exercise. Dips work the chest and the triceps as main movers, and the smith incline and chest press (7 sets) use the triceps too. That gives triceps 8 direct sets a week (dips 3, rope pushdown 3, overhead extension 2), inside the range. The overhead cable extension came off Push A on 1 November because at this gym that slot was being done as dips. That review said it comes back if you want it, and that still stands: say so in a note and it returns.

One program change: dips now run 12 to 15 reps instead of 8 to 12 (version 13). You did 12 on all three on 15 November, the top of the old range, and there is no weight to add on this card. Next Push A (22 November) asks 13 on all three.

Everything on Push A held or went up on 15 November: smith incline 180 for 6, 7, 8 (next time 180 on all four sets, aiming for 8); crossover 12.5 for 15 on all three (next time 15); lateral raise 17.5 for 12 on all three, so 17.5 is the weight now; reverse pec deck 97.5 for 12 on all three (next time 13).

If tomorrow's review does not reach the app before you train, the app's own Pull A card is close to right. Use deadlift 215, 235, 245, 250 for 5; seated row 112.5 for 10 on all four; dumbbell curl 35 for 8 on all three. Three numbers to change: wide pulldown 135 for 8 on all three sets (the card opens at 112.5 and 127.5), hammer curl 42.5 on all three sets (the card opens at 39), and face pulls 32.5 for 15 on both sets (the card shows 32 for 12).

Still open: if calf press is skipped again on Legs A on 18 November, which calf machine does the New York gym have? If the shrug's fourth set is missing again on 20 November, the card drops to three sets. Your logs are still stamped Meso 3, week 7; if the phase at the top of the app is locked, the 25 November deload will not start by itself, and "Automatic (by date)" clears the lock. There is no bodyweight logged since 23 August, so a morning weigh-in would help.

One question I am leaving open: you asked on 2 and 10 November whether the set counts are supported. Front delts, rear delts, upper back, biceps, triceps and forearms sit inside their ranges if only direct sets count, but above them if every compound lift's helper work is counted. Until the program is rebuilt on 9 December, those six get more total work than the ranges say; that rebuild settles the count on one rule for every muscle.

Today: rest. An easy 20 to 30 minute walk or bike ride is fine. Eat and sleep like it is a training day.
